title: Latvian Prime Minister Kulbergs enjoys his rally passion with weekend win
summary_full: While the attention of most of the motorsports world over the weekend was focussed on the crowning of the youngest ever Formula 1 world champion, Kimi Antonelli, 20, at the Mexican Grand Prix, there was a slightly slower motor race being run in the suburbs of Rīga involving a slightly older but no less remarkable personality.
